variables.name: Content 2
variables.initialValue: I’ve stayed at beach resorts all over the world, but this one stands out. The staff were beyond welcoming, the views were unreal, and the room felt like a dream. I didn’t want to leave.

variables.name: Content 3
variables.initialValue: From the kids’ beach toys to the spacious suite, everything was thoughtfully designed for families. The beach was steps away, and we made memories we’ll treasure forever.
